pages.heading: France at a Glance
pages.subhead: A country with many landscapes and a long history.

blocks.content: France is in Western Europe. Its mainland includes Atlantic and Mediterranean coasts, broad plains, and the Alps and Pyrenees mountain ranges.
Paris is home to landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre. France also includes historic towns, agricultural regions, forests, and mountain communities.
France has regions and territories beyond mainland Europe, so the country's geography is more varied than this short introduction can cover.
